description:
Xenition lets ChatGPT create, edit, and organize your work.

Turn a prompt into finished output — slide decks, documents from 200+
ready-made templates (invoices, resumes, proposals, agendas), 3D models,
Kanban boards, spreadsheets, and no-code apps. Everything you make is
saved so you can reopen and keep editing it.

Work with what you already have: search your documents, summarize them,
pull out specific data, query your spreadsheets, edit in place, get a
review with comments, or turn one file into another format. Ask questions
answered only from your own files.

Stay on top of your day: check your calendar, add and complete tasks,
take notes, track invoices, and see everything on your plate at a glance.
Run your saved agents in the background and publish any result as a public
link to share.

defaultPrompt: Build a 6-slide deck introducing our new product to a sales team
Create a shareable RSVP form for our team offsite — name, email, attending
Have my Researcher agent gather the current EU rules on AI transparency
